interpretation.roundingContext: A standalone stored Float32 coefficient match does not establish the evaluation route of the original consumer expression after shader compilation. Materializing w in storage can change contraction or rounding context in sum+w*pressure(n) and fixed(w*inputP[c].x,neighborScale(...)), including integer quantization of gas-neighbor contributions. These are plausible routes, not demonstrated compiler-IR or per-dispatch evidence.
interpretation.notDetermined: No intermediate per-iteration consumer captures or compiler IR were retained. The evidence does not identify the exact first arithmetic operation, prove a compiler contraction cause, or measure physical impact.
